status: Research-only protocol and source-first expectations; no production rule adoption

priorResearch.reuse: Existing source expectations, current full reports and identity evidence; do not merge, cherry-pick or overwrite branch

unit: Source-grounded ability/branch relative to an anchor; composition operates on confidently resolved physical Oracle identities and retains independent membership evidence

frozenExpectations.expected: Qualifying own nontoken death can trigger opponents' creature sacrifice; interaction is an event response, not an exclusion. Verify native trigger and affected players before projecting any relationship.

Own land entry event response with extra draw gated on this ability resolving for the second time in a turn. Verify exact source; triggering is not resolving. Internal ability history is significant but not an independently promoted state anchor.
Printed ordinary tap-for-one land mana tests baseline beyond intrinsic basic-land-type abilities. Basic land selection should recover it without claiming a distinctive focused engine.

Tap-for-one mana on a creature challenges category-relative ordinary baseline: may be distinctive relative to creatures but conventional mana-dork functionality. Do not automatically solve the baseline through amount or printed text.
Tap for two colorless demonstrates quantity distinct from one mana, but amount alone does not establish a universal engine or baseline category policy. No loop or value claim.

Overloaded bounce is a broad board wipe without producing deaths. A functional board-wipe tag may validly retrieve it while being insufficient evidence for mass destruction or a creature-death relationship.

Destroy plus token for the destroyed permanent's controller; extra outcome does not automatically supply the required original nontoken creature or event dependency. Verify exact target/controller and native availability.
Ordinary land/mana recovered through basic source metadata. Retain prior native eligibility UNKNOWN; external eligibility is distinct, not an authorized correction.
Focused primary exclusion; basic removal retrieval does not change mechanical death possibility or grant focused membership.
Focused primary exclusion under the revised model even though it includes own creatures. Basic board-wipe selection retrieves it; union preserves that reason.
Same interaction-only primary boundary as Wrath; retain compatibility and basic membership.
Qualifying sacrifice-cost contribution remains included; preserve activation, target and output association. Removal is a separate contribution.
Another own nontoken death causes draw through a supported event relationship.
Original self-return supplies potential nontoken material; no death or repeated loop is implied.

Current historical enhanced-removal match retained in original evidence; proposed event selection withholds its history-only pathway. A creature died this turn is a historical state with broader subject scope, not our nontoken event.
Own land-entry response and independently meaningful six-land condition at resolution can overlap; unsupported branches remain uncertain and are not manufactured matches.
Replacement modifies impending positive counter placement on own creature; does not initiate placement or become a triggered response.
Basic creature-card selection includes ordinary material without adding a focused supply relationship.
Symmetrical sacrifice-only interaction challenges the boundary with costs. Revised primary expectation excludes the interaction-only effect, rather than admitting every SACRIFICE operation.

experiment: Use the unchanged current death report for a five-color eligible commander so Wrath is not excluded merely by color. Keep original results, checks and eligibility intact.

Create a read-only projected event selection: retain current accepted direct, supplier and draw/token response paths; retain legacy enhanced-removal paths only where their recorded native action is a supported direct death trigger. History-only and unresolved associations remain separately visible. This reuses current policies, not proof that a general admission algorithm exists.

Select ordinary land/creature cards and printed power thresholds from retained external structured metadata with explicit normal-layout scope. Observe live Scryfall search syntax and functional tag results; pin queries and original responses with timestamps and hashes.

Restrict live functional membership to the same retained external Oracle population and commander legality/identity scope; report live-only, missing, changed identity and unavailable-native cases without coercing identity.

Union focused contributors with a basic board-wipe selection; intersect focused contributors with basic creature selection. Deduplicate physical Oracle identity while retaining all selection memberships and ability/path evidence.

Do not put manual expected classifications into accepted mechanical results. Source expectation overlays remain explicit, including event/state/internal-history/modification examples with unsupported facts.

Test ambiguous identity, missing native definitions, same-card multiple paths, same-name different identities, token versus original card, tag breadth, empty sets, conflicting context and historical versus event dependencies.
limits: Known-card purposive controls, not blinded qualification. Seven new controls are frozen before source/native outcome inspection. No production changes, general extractor, permanent composition schema, rules parser or strategic classifier. No inferred multi-card causal chain or recommendation from union/intersection.
